newsitem.title: INDIA: India 96/97 soybean crop seen at 4.06 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: India 96/97 soybean crop seen at 4.06 mln tonnes.

text.p: India's 1996/97 (November-October) soybean crop is estimated at 4.06 million tonnes, down from 4.45 million in the previous season, an official of the Central Organisation of Oil Industry and Trade (COOIT) said on Sunday.

"COOIT had estimated the 1996/97 soybean crop at the beginning of the season in November at 4.06 million tonnes and has kept it unchanged," the official told a seminar on India's summer oilseeds in the northern city of Agra.
The Soybean Processors Association of India had estimated 1996/97 soybean output at 4.0 million tonnes.

Traders say a delay in the onset of the monsoon, intermittent heavy rain, cloudy weather, lack of dry spells with bright sunshine and then heavy rain in the third and fourth weeks of October in the central Indian state of Madhya Pradesh have contributed to the fall in output.
Madhya Pradesh accounts for nearly 80 percent of the country's soybean production.
